To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the transmission view of discourse is inadequate and that management discourse needs management.
the discourse of management is not a transmission tool, that it requires management, and that management requires an ethics of communication.

(1) the transmission view of discourse is inadequate for the study of management discourse; (2) management discourse is more than a means of transmitting information, it is a means of constructing and negotiating reality, and (3) managers need to be aware of the ethical implications of discourse and to manage their discourse.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the management of management discourse.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
discourse is a complex phenomenon, a social process that is a fundamental aspect of management, one that is inextricably bound up with the management task.
discourse is the most important tool in the management toolbox, and the management of that tool, in turn, requires a comprehensive and detailed management toolbox.
the discourse of management is the management of discourse.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
discourse is the medium of managerial activity, and management is the medium of discourse.
discourse is a pervasive tool for management, and that the management of discourse is a necessary tool of management.
management of discourse is the process of managing the discourse of management, a process of management of discourse.
The main takeaway from our work is that
discourse is a complex phenomenon that needs to be understood in its own terms, not as a mere means to an end.
the discourse of management is a complex and fluid phenomenon that requires not only effective use but also management itself.
the discourse of management is an ethical and aesthetic activity.
